It reads the fact sheet, your first drafts and the playbook's conclusions.<div style="margin-top:6px;color:#2d7600;font-size:13px;"><b>Today:</b> the stand-in list by default; <b>AI writer</b>: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash via OpenRouter</div>" vertex="1"><mxGeometry height="280" width="300" x="40" y="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="i_writer" parent="1" style="html=1;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#3d6fb0;fillColor=none;shape=mxgraph.ios7.icons.compose;" value="" vertex="1"><mxGeometry height="38" width="38" x="54" y="124" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="checks" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;spacingTop=8;fontSize=14;strokeWidth=1.5;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" value="<div style="padding-left:58px;min-height:46px;"><span style="font-size:17px;"><b>2 · Checks</b></span><br><span style="font-size:13px;color:#555555;"><i>fixed rules, not a model</i></span></div>Every draft must pass:<div style="padding-left:12px;text-indent:-12px;">• figures exactly as on the fact sheet; no Trialist offers in Idle</div><div style="padding-left:12px;text-indent:-12px;">• no banned phrase</div><div style="padding-left:12px;text-indent:-12px;">• no fake “Re:” or “Fwd:”</div><div style="padding-left:12px;text-indent:-12px;">• subject within 60 characters, known placeholders, a button</div><div style="margin-top:4px;">A failing draft is rewritten, with the reasons, and never sent.</div><div style="margin-top:6px;color:#2d7600;font-size:13px;"><b>Today:</b> in front of the AI writer</div>" vertex="1"><mxGeometry height="280" width="300" x="450" y="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="i_checks" parent="1" style="html=1;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#3d6fb0;fillColor=none;shape=mxgraph.ios7.icons.looking_glass;" value="" vertex="1"><mxGeometry height="38" width="38" x="464" y="124" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="judge" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;spacingTop=8;fontSize=14;strokeWidth=1.5;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" value="<div style="padding-left:58px;min-height:46px;"><span style="font-size:17px;"><b>3 · Judge</b></span><br><span style="font-size:13px;color:#555555;"><i>a decision model, simulation only</i></span></div>Rates each new part once, from 1 to 10, against your first draft. The rating becomes its hidden quality, plus noise: the judge stands in for merchants and is not taken as truth. Written and judged once per run, shared by every replay.<div style="margin-top:6px;color:#2d7600;font-size:13px;"><b>Today:</b> <b>AI writer</b>: TypeSafe Jev 1.14 via OpenRouter's Decisions API; the div.div:
2 · Checks
fixed rules, not a modelEvery draft must pass:
• figures exactly as on the fact sheet; no Trialist offers in Idle
• no banned phrase
• no fake “Re:” or “Fwd:”
• subject within 60 characters, known placeholders, a button
A failing draft is rewritten, with the reasons, and never sent.
Today: in front of the AI writer
